messages:
alex: Quick async standup — canary rollout update for feature flag ff/chat-autoscale. Canary currently at ~5% in prod/us-west. Seeing a small bump in p95 latency on model-serving-v2 for seq >1024. Did: rolled out batch_size=8 pin for v2 and collected traces. Blocker: want to validate fallback to v1 if latencies exceed SLOs. Today: running warmup and adding extra tracing.

sasha: Noted. Running a targeted warmup job for the us-west slice now (warmup script + light traffic). ETA ~25m. @kevin can you confirm autoscaler won't spin up extra lower-priority pools during this warmup? :thumbsup:

kevin: Confirmed autoscaler policy — warmup traffic should prefer pre-warmed instances and not trigger new dedicated pools. Pushed a metric filter to alert on any new pool starts. Will watch dashboards.

jordan: PM note — if we breach SLOs, toggle ff to 0% and enable fallback to v1 per runbook. I updated the runbook with the exact thresholds. Link: https://go/runbooks/canary-fallback

alex: Roger. I'll flip the flag if we hit 2x baseline error or 2x baseline p95. Sharing a quick trace snippet I pulled:
```
trace_id=abc123 service=model-v2 op=decode latency=312ms seq_len=1500 kv_miss=true
```

maya: QA: Running regen test suite against the long-prompt set. Found one structured-output parsing assertion fail for prompt case 12. Investigating whether it's model behavior or prompt template change. Will update in ~30m.

deploy-bot: deploy completed: canary slice us-west-2 scaled to 5% at 2026-03-17T08:45Z — no config drift detected.

sasha: After the warmup, tail p95 dropped ~20ms overall, still seeing occasional spikes (~1-2/min). @alex can you enable span-level logging for spans >200ms for next 2h?

alex: Enabled span-level logging and increased trace sampling for high-latency spans. Also adding a temporary traffic mirror to staging to reproduce with higher seq lengths.

kevin: I'll keep an eye on infra metrics and open a ticket if any new pool creation or OOMs occur. Metrics filter will page at +1 pool start.

maya: QA update: the structured-output failure looks like a prompt-template mismatch. The v1 template produces correct output for the failing cases. Suggesting temporary config rollback to v1 template while we root-cause.

alex: Okay. I'll flip the template in experiments for the canary group and monitor. If stable after +2h we'll proceed to 20% ramp. :rocket:
